aesthetic: Scholarly Press — an aged-paper ground with measured Swiss typesetting, evoking a mid-century design annual where the silence between lines carries as much weight as the text itself
chromaticArc: Slides open and hold on Aged Paper White through the first movement; two chapter-break slides shift to Antique Parchment mid-deck; Deep Espresso appears only as headline type on those dividers; the deck returns to warm white for the close, the ground undisturbed.
gridStrategy: Title-only slides rest on the centred axis (cols 12–48) with a deep top margin; body slides anchor all text to col 12 in a 36-col measure leaving both flanks open; the two chapter breaks collapse to a single isolated title zone, enlarged and vertically centred.

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: No secondary font — all type is set in Helvetica Neue; weight and tracking variation (300 for headlines, 400 for body, 0.12em on labels) provide the sole differentiation across the deck

accentStrategy: No decorative accents; spatial tension is created exclusively through asymmetric whitespace and measure contrast — a single 0.5px hairline rule in Warm Sienna appears only on the two chapter-break slides to demarcate the title zone from the folio number.
